selection: One epoch per mode minimizing max across roles of mean SB-hRMSE/reference; tie mean then earliest epoch. Reference is existing train-only fixed prior; used only for normalization.
scope: Repeated-use inner development only; no outer validation/test forecasts for selection. No refit at this stage.
change: Same linear replacement RNG across candidates. Pair loss only on profiles actually replaced. No view loss for k0/k1.
eligible_interval: No active dose start or infusion stop in CLOSED bracket including endpoints. Singleton endpoint blocks only. k=0/1 unchanged. Ongoing infusion without boundaries allowed and approximation acknowledged.
augmentation_scope: Same-profile interpolation, not cross-patient/drug mixup. Original arrays preserved. No query concentration or validation data used to make synthetic support.
diagnostic: Use prior interpolation diagnostic; record view losses, hidden dispersion, eligible negative counts; verify original controls.
secondary_evaluation: k=0/1/4 at k=2-selected checkpoints; no reselection.
selection_scope: Repeated-use inner development; alpha and temperature fixed before runs; no outer evaluation.
representation: Final GRU hidden at common cutoff, L2 normalized, identity projection (no extra trainable head), both branches differentiable.
forecast_loss: Original history only for view losses; replacement history for linear_interp control.
negative_policy: Other source-scoped participants among actually replaced training profiles. Same recorded source/participant excluded including coadministered drugs. Unknown cross-source linkage remains a data limitation.
